'''Riverside Robotics Club''' is a student club at [[Riverside High School]]. Elena Ruiz is the science teacher at Riverside High School. She advises the Riverside Robotics Club. [[File:Helios_Solar_Car.svg|thumb|The Helios Solar Car]] == The Helios project == The club built the [[Helios Solar Car]] for the [[Brookdale Science Fair]]. Noah Kim leads the Helios project. === The team === Noah Kim is a student at Riverside High School. Priya Shah is also a student at Riverside High School. * Noah Kim builds the car body. * Priya Shah connects the battery. * Elena Ruiz checks the safety plan. # The team chooses a design. # The team builds the solar car. # The team tests the solar car. === Equipment === {| class="wikitable" ! Item !! Owner !! Use |- | Solar panel || Riverside Robotics Club || Collects sunlight |- | Battery || Riverside Robotics Club || Stores energy |- | Small motor || Noah Kim || Moves the car |}
Elena Ruiz says that the team should test the car before the science fair.
---- The team tests the Helios Solar Car in the science laboratory. The science laboratory is inside Riverside High School.The laboratory has tables, tools, and a charging station.

'''Riverside High School''' is a public school in Brookdale.
Maya Singh is the principal of Riverside High School.
== People ==
Elena Ruiz teaches science at Riverside High School. Noah Kim and Priya Shah study at Riverside High School.
== Places ==
The science laboratory is inside Riverside High School. The science laboratory is next to the school library.
== School event ==
Riverside High School hosts the Brookdale Science Fair every spring.

'''Brookdale Science Fair''' takes place at Riverside High School.
Noah Kim presents the Helios Solar Car at the Brookdale Science Fair. Priya Shah helps Noah Kim during the presentation.
== Awards ==
Maya Singh gives the teamwork award to the Riverside Robotics Club.
The award recognizes the work of Noah Kim, Priya Shah, and Elena Ruiz.
